lines.en: Welcome, Dan. The flat was painted last month, so the walls are fresh.
lines.pt: Bem-vindo, Dan. O apartamento foi pintado no mês passado, então as paredes estão novas.

lines.en: It looks nice. Was the carpet cleaned too?
lines.pt: Está bonito. O tapete também foi limpo?

lines.en: Yes, it was cleaned last week. The old tiles in the kitchen were replaced.
lines.pt: Sim, foi limpo na semana passada. Os azulejos velhos da cozinha foram trocados.

lines.en: Good. I see a crack in the ceiling, though. Was it repaired?
lines.pt: Bom. Mas vejo uma rachadura no teto. Ela foi consertada?

lines.en: Yes, it was repaired in May. The stain was caused by an old pipe.
lines.pt: Sim, foi consertada em maio. A mancha foi causada por um cano velho.

lines.en: And when was the building built? It looks very old.
lines.pt: E quando o prédio foi construído? Parece muito antigo.

lines.en: It was built in 1920. The windows were changed ten years ago.
lines.pt: Foi construído em 1920. As janelas foram trocadas há dez anos.

lines.en: Was the wallpaper in the bedroom chosen by the owner?
lines.pt: O papel de parede do quarto foi escolhido pelo proprietário?

lines.en: Yes, it was chosen by him in 2019. We can remove it if you like.
lines.pt: Sim, foi escolhido por ele em 2019. Podemos tirar se você quiser.

lines.en: I like it. Was the wardrobe left here by the last tenant?
lines.pt: Eu gosto dele. O guarda-roupa foi deixado aqui pelo último inquilino?

lines.en: Yes, it was. The old tenant was happy to leave it, so it’s free.
lines.pt: Foi, sim. O antigo inquilino ficou feliz em deixá-lo, então é de graça.

facts.label: O que foi feito
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio: The flat was painted. The tiles were replaced. Pergunte com Was it cleaned? e diga quem fez com by.

facts.label: Foi/foram + particípio
facts.sub: Use was ou were com o particípio para dizer o que foi feito: The flat was painted. The tiles were replaced. O foco é a coisa, não quem fez.

facts.label: Por + quem fez
facts.sub: Use by para dizer quem fez, quando importa: It was chosen by the owner. The report was written by Cody. Se quem fez não importa, não use by.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Was painted is a passive form in the past.
We say “The flat painted last month.”
items.why: We say The flat was painted last month.

items.s: Were is used with plural things, like tiles.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Was painted is a passive form in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The flat painted last month.” → Falso (We say The flat was painted last month.)
Were is used with plural things, like tiles. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A flat in Melbourne · 1/3
paragraphs: Dan is looking for a flat in Melbourne. Today he is visiting an old building. The agent, Cody, opens the front door. Everything inside looks fresh and clean. Dan has many questions. He wants to know what was done.

“Welcome, Dan. The flat was painted last month, so the walls are fresh.” says Cody. “It looks nice. Was the carpet cleaned too?” says Dan. “Yes, it was cleaned last week. The old tiles in the kitchen were replaced.” says Cody.
